# Local Grid Cartesian Reference Frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:referenceFrameLocalGrid`](gmeow-referenceFrameLocalGrid.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/referenceFrameLocalGrid>
- **Category:** individual
